pack.note: SG-1 declaration only. Supported legal forms: sg-sole-prop (sole_prop), sg-pte (pte_ltd), sg-llp (llp), from server/donna/singapore/entity.js and src/lib/legalForms.js. sg-llc and general partnerships remain unsupported. The shared pack schema has no legal-form/application predicate leg; these notes do not enforce admission. No signup, provisioning, filing or production flag activation. See docs/donna-country-pack-contract-gaps.md SG-1 addendum.

languages.note: English correspondence only; other Singapore languages are not authored.

reference.note: No Singapore structured payment reference scheme is registered.

einvoice.note: InvoiceNow/Peppol is declared_unbuilt in obligations; none describes current transport support, not absence of the duty.

tax.note: Matches the live SG_CODING_POLICY and TAX_VOCABULARY_REGISTRY.sg marker. The richer sg_gst dated vocabulary remains owned by singapore/gstCodes.js and its separate gates; this declaration does not enable GST split posting. Existing statutory module confirmation flags remain false at the base of SG-1; SG-2 draft PR #2241 needs qualified review. No rates, thresholds or deadlines are duplicated here.

reconciliation.note: Existing Donna policy (RT-11 D2 / RT-11b, Kari 2026-07-06): 500 in home currency for each ceiling. Not a statutory threshold or a new production flag grant.

payment_rails.note: Use the owner-provided Singapore bank transfer, PayNow or GIRO instructions verbatim. No typed PayNow/GIRO validation, mandate, QR generation, payment initiation or settlement adapter is declared. Do not substitute IBAN, ACH or sort-code semantics.

constraints: No late interest, fees or legal-threat wording: no provenanced Singapore statutory basis is declared. Escalate unpaid invoices to the owner. Cadence offsets are Donna correspondence policy, not statutory deadlines.

documents.note: Full tax-invoice field declaration from IRAS Invoicing Customers, read 2026-09-24: https://www.iras.gov.sg/taxes/goods-services-tax-(gst)/basics-of-gst/invoicing-price-display-and-record-keeping/invoicing-customers . This pack uses the full invoice floor for registered sellers; simplified/customer-accounting documents are not implemented. Schema-valid templates cannot display addresses, seller GST number or GST totals without the unrelated buyer-registration floor required by invoice_statutory_labels. No buyer GST-number requirement is invented to bypass that validator. Foreign-currency SGD-equivalent totals and supply-type subtotals are also unserved. These are open contract gaps, not compliant SG GST invoice issuance. SG launch remains blocked; see the SG-1 addendum.

chart_of_accounts.note: Preserves the existing SG_CODING_POLICY fallback menu exactly. Not an SFRS chart seed or a statutory numbering system. The richer form-specific chart and GST control roles remain in server/donna/singapore/sfrsChart.js; their provisioning is SG-3, not SG-1. Tax payable is not re-labelled as a GST output control account.

obligations.note: SG-1 inventory of GST, income-tax and ACRA duties for the admitted forms. Applicability is recorded in each note, not enforced by the pack schema. Every item remains declared_unbuilt because no SG binding exists in the shared sweep. Existing pure/domain modules do not imply a mounted lifecycle. This is not a certification of all employment, sector-specific or cross-border duties.

items.name: GST registration assessment and owner application
items.note: Applies to sg-sole-prop, sg-pte and sg-llp where registration liability must be assessed; distinguish registered businesses from prospective/retrospective registration assessment. The owner/firm registers. A historical warning is not proof of liability. Source is the existing module read on 2026-09-24, not a new primary verification; confirmedAgainstPrimary remains false on the SG-1 base. SG-2 #2241 corrections require qualified Singapore review. No statutory sweep binding, filing or production flag is activated.

items.name: GST return preparation, review and filing obligation
items.note: Applies to GST-registered sg-sole-prop, sg-pte and sg-llp for their prescribed accounting periods. Preserve nil-return and period obligations; F5 preparation is not filing. Existing code/box tables and gated transport are not certified coverage. SG-6 owns lifecycle; SG-8 owns split posting; A11 filing belongs to the firm. Source is the existing module read on 2026-09-24, not a new primary verification; confirmedAgainstPrimary remains false on the SG-1 base. SG-2 #2241 corrections require qualified Singapore review. No statutory sweep binding, filing or production flag is activated.

items.name: Estimated Chargeable Income assessment
items.note: Applies to sg-pte; assess the ECI filing waiver from both annual revenue and nil estimated chargeable income, never legal form alone. Does not apply to sg-sole-prop or sg-llp. Financial-year-end/deadline arithmetic remains module-owned. Source is the existing module read on 2026-09-24, not a new primary verification; confirmedAgainstPrimary remains false on the SG-1 base. SG-2 #2241 corrections require qualified Singapore review. No statutory sweep binding, filing or production flag is activated.

items.name: Corporate income-tax return and assessment
items.note: Applies to sg-pte. Form C-S Lite / C-S / C selection, exemptions and any filing waiver require qualifying facts; size alone is insufficient. Sole proprietors and LLP partners have separate income-tax duties below. No YA-specific rebate is promised. Source is the existing module read on 2026-09-24, not a new primary verification; confirmedAgainstPrimary remains false on the SG-1 base. SG-2 #2241 corrections require qualified Singapore review. No statutory sweep binding, filing or production flag is activated.

items.name: Annual general meeting or evidenced exemption
items.note: Applies to the supported non-listed sg-pte lane unless a valid exemption/dispensation applies. Requires financial-year-end, meeting and exemption evidence; do not infer an exemption merely from private-company status. Not the sole-proprietor or LLP lane. Source is the existing module read on 2026-09-24, not a new primary verification; confirmedAgainstPrimary remains false on the SG-1 base. SG-2 #2241 corrections require qualified Singapore review. No statutory sweep binding, filing or production flag is activated.

items.name: Company annual return
items.note: Applies to supported non-listed sg-pte, including where AGM is exempt. The annual return remains distinct from the meeting and financial-statement/XBRL requirements. sg-sole-prop and sg-llp do not acquire a company annual-return obligation. Source is the existing module read on 2026-09-24, not a new primary verification; confirmedAgainstPrimary remains false on the SG-1 base. SG-2 #2241 corrections require qualified Singapore review. No statutory sweep binding, filing or production flag is activated.

items.name: Financial-statement filing and XBRL requirement
items.source: Companies Act and ACRA financial-statement filing requirements; server/donna/singapore/acraAnnualReturn.js (xbrlRequirementFor)
items.note: Applies to sg-pte where financial statements must be filed. Existing assessment distinguishes solvent exempt private companies from companies requiring full/simplified XBRL, using exemption, solvency, size and public-accountability facts. Exemption from filing is not blanket exemption from preparation or annual return. Unsupported specialised XBRL/financial-statement cases need review, not a guessed tier. Source is the existing module read on 2026-09-24, not a new primary verification; confirmedAgainstPrimary remains false on the SG-1 base. SG-2 #2241 corrections require qualified Singapore review. No statutory sweep binding, filing or production flag is activated.

items.name: Sole-proprietor business income in owner return
items.note: Applies to sg-sole-prop: business income is assessed on the owner through the applicable personal return (Form B/B1), not ECI/Form C-S. The entity module refuses company-only artifacts; there is no personal-return lifecycle in this pack. This module-derived scope remains unverified.

items.name: LLP partnership return and partner income assessment
items.note: Applies to sg-llp: Form P and partner assessment, not company ECI/Form C-S. The entity module refuses company-only artifacts; the partnership/partner-return lifecycle is unbuilt. LLP-specific ACRA declarations are not served by the company annual-return calculator and require a separate surveyed binding. This module-derived scope remains unverified.

items.name: GST InvoiceNow data-submission requirement
items.note: Primary page read 2026-09-24: phased InvoiceNow participation for GST-registered businesses. Applicability requires registration history and the assigned implementation phase; no universal effective date is inferred. The pack has no InvoiceNow transport, applicability evaluator or submission receipt. einvoice.lane=none records that implementation gap, not exemption from the obligation.

items.name: GST tax-invoice content and evidence
items.note: Primary page read 2026-09-24. Applies to GST-registered suppliers issuing tax invoices; the document declarations preserve the full floor. Shared display tokens, foreign-currency SGD equivalents and supply-type subtotals remain unserved. Simplified/customer-accounting variants are not implemented. Pack discovery and a successful invoice-model build are not compliant SG invoice rendering.

items.name: LLP annual declaration
items.note: Applies to sg-llp, independently of the partnership income-tax return. ACRA, Filing annual declarations for limited liability partnerships (LLPs), retrieved 2026-09-24: "All limited liability partnerships (LLPs) in Singapore must file annual declarations". No company annual-return calculator, deadline, filing capability or confirmation of existing module tables is implied.

items.name: Sole-proprietor business registration renewal
items.note: Applies to sg-sole-prop with a business registration requiring renewal; distinct from company annual returns and LLP declarations. ACRA, Compliance requirements: Businesses and registered professionals, retrieved 2026-09-24, names "renewal of business registration" for sole proprietorships. No renewal term, date, fee, automated renewal or exemption is inferred.
